p: Engedi: A city of Judah, Jos 15:62.
Behold the day of which the: Here we see how ready we are to hasten God's promise, if the occasion serve never so little.
smote him: For seeing it was his own private cause, he repented that he had touched his enemy.
Wherefore hearest thou men's words: Contrary to the report of those who said David was Saul's enemy, he proves himself to be his friend.
Is this thy voice: Though he was a cruel enemy to David, yet by his great gentleness his conscience compelled him to yield.
know well that thou shalt surely: Though this tyrant saw and confessed the favour of God toward David, yet he did not cease to persecute him against his own conscience.
